newsitem.title: MEXICO: GEO says to issue new shares.
newsitem.headline: GEO says to issue new shares.

text.p: Mexican builder Corporacion Geo SA will issue 13.8 million additional shares this week, worth about $80 million, as part of a global public offering, company officials said on Monday.
"We will place 13.8 million shares, of which 2.7 million will go to investors in Mexico and the remainder to investors in the United States and Europe," a company spokesman told Reuters.
"The offer is worth about 16.8 percent of the company's total share capital, which right now is 82 million shares," said the spokesman, who wished to remain anonymous.
He said the price of the shares would be between 37.5 and 45 pesos.

The company plans to use about $25 million to expand its operations in Chile and Texas and another $25 million for new business in the Mexican states of Tlaxcala, Nuevo Len and Puebla, according to the spokesman. An additional $25 million will be used to retire debt, he said.
Casa de Bolsa Bancomer will act as lead manager of the deal in Mexico, while Violy, Byron and Partners will manage the international placement.
